Hey Coaches, our next presenters are Damien Morris and Louise Broadfoot, who are part of the integrity team at Tennis Australia. They both play a pivotal role in keeping our sport safe and today they're going to share some of their information around child safety and how to make your environment a child safe environment both on and off the court. Damien and Louise, welcome. Thank you for joining us for our Safeguarding Children on and off the court session. My name is Damien Morris and today I'm joined by my colleague Louise Broadfoot and we're both senior integrity officers with the Tennis Australia Integrity and Compliance Unit. So at Tennis Australia we take our commitment to the safeguarding of children very seriously. So I now want to play you a video from our CEO Craig Tiley. We have a zero-tolerance approach to any form of child abuse and are committed to ensuring the sport of tennis is a safe and friendly environment for children. It is imperative that children who access our activities, our programs, our events or our services feel safe and supported. We will ensure that child safety is embedded in our organization's culture, reflected in our policies and procedures, and understood and practiced at all levels of our sport.
